description: Smart Push Notifications - Contextual reminders based on user behavior: lunch log reminder at 2pm, pushup time at usual workout time, streak celebration in evening, protein deficit suggestion at 7pm, weekly summary on Sunday.
steps: Create supabase/functions/smart-notifications/index.ts - CRON Edge Function (uses requireCron) that runs every hour and checks user behavior to send contextual notifications. Logic: (1) At 2pm IST: for users with no food_log since their last breakfast log today, send 'Lunch log nahi kiya' notification. (2) At user's usual workout time (derive from median pushup_sessions.started_at hour): send 'Pushup time! Sirf 10 min' if no session today. (3) At 8pm IST: for users with 3+ day pushup streak, send '3-day streak! Don't break it tomorrow' celebration. (4) At 7pm IST: for users whose today's food_log protein total < daily_protein_target - 30g, send 'Aaj protein Xg short hai - dinner mein paneer try karo'. (5) On Sunday 10am IST: send weekly summary with total food logs, pushups, avg protein. Uses recordAndSendNotification from _shared/notifications.ts for each notification.

Update supabase/functions/_shared/notifications.ts - Add a helper function `sendSmartNotification(userId, title, body, channel)` that wraps recordAndSendNotification with the standard notification payload format including title, body, and channel fields.

Create supabase/migrations/008_notification_preferences.sql - Add a `notification_preferences` table: user_id (uuid PK FK users), lunch_reminder (boolean default true), pushup_reminder (boolean default true), streak_alerts (boolean default true), protein_tips (boolean default true), weekly_summary (boolean default true), preferred_workout_hour (int, nullable - auto-detected if null), updated_at (timestamptz). RLS: user can read/update their own row. Insert default row in handle_new_auth_user trigger.

Update lib/services/notification_service.dart - Add methods: (1) `getNotificationPreferences()` - fetches user's notification_preferences from Supabase, (2) `updateNotificationPreferences(Map<String, bool> prefs)` - updates preferences. Add new notification channels: 'smart_reminders' for contextual reminders, 'weekly_summary' for weekly summaries.

Create lib/screens/settings/notification_settings_screen.dart - Screen with toggle switches for each notification type (lunch reminder, pushup reminder, streak alerts, protein tips, weekly summary). Uses the existing settings screen pattern. Each toggle updates the notification_preferences table via NotificationService.
Wire the notification settings screen into the existing settings navigation (lib/screens/settings/) so users can access it from their profile/settings area.
acceptance_criteria: smart-notifications Edge Function checks user behavior at appropriate hours and sends contextual notifications
Notification content matches the specified messages (Hindi-English mix style matching existing app tone)
notification_preferences table allows users to opt in/out of each notification type
Smart notification function respects user preferences before sending
NotificationSettingsScreen shows all 5 toggles and persists changes
Weekly summary notification includes actual stats (food logs count, pushups done, avg protein)
Edge Function handles timezone correctly (IST = UTC+5:30)
verification: Verify SQL migration is syntactically valid
Verify Edge Function imports and uses requireCron correctly (matching daily-pushup-check pattern)
Verify notification service Dart methods have correct Supabase query syntax
Verify settings screen follows existing screen patterns
